mapper.select: select abr.balance_record_id as balanceRecordId, abr.account_id as accountId, a.nick_name as accountNickName, a.mobile as accountMobile, abr.record_type as recordType, abr.change_type as changeType, abr.change_amount as changeAmount, abr.balance_before as balanceBefore, abr.balance_after as balanceAfter, abr.biz_id as bizId, abr.biz_no as bizNo, abr.remark as remark, abr.create_time as createTime from account_balance_record abr left join account a on abr.account_id = a.account_id and a.del_flag = 0 where abr.balance_record_id = #{balanceRecordId} and abr.del_flag = 0
